title: Chemical Equation Balancer
description: Type an unbalanced chemical equation; the program finds whole-number coefficients that conserve every element.
versionOrder: Inferred development sequence, not established dates. The 1979 family precedes Chemistry Balancer II (copyright 1981). Within each family the order follows source changes; within a capture, save order. Tape numbers alone do not establish chronology.

versions.label: 1979 · First balancer
versions.note: Floating-point Gaussian elimination; no parentheses. Rescales by reciprocal fractional parts until coefficients are whole.
versions.unavailableReason: Source only. On this site the Level II BASIC player runs v20, the latest version; this listing and payload remain downloadable.

versions.label: CHEMISTRY BALENCER II EARLY
versions.note: Previously listed separately as Chemistry Balancer II — earlier experiments v01. The recovered source credits Carl Kadie. Any earlier published sources have not been established. validated payload; runtime untested. 53 consistent BASIC record pointers; normal end marker; matching audio variants/timing decodes; not execution-tested
versions.unavailableReason: Another recovered save; the site offers one selected player.
versions.startupSource:
5 CLS
10 REM CHEMISTRY BALENCER II   COPYRIGHT 1981 C. KADIE
90 CLEAR 1000:DEFINT A-Z
100 PRINT:PRINT:PRINT"WHAT IS THE EQUATION":INPUT EQ$
110 EQ$="I(I3(I5(I7)2)4)6=H.H.H.H.H(H)3":PRINTEQ$
200 ' REM  DECIPHER EQUATION
210 ' HOW MANY ELEMENTS?
220  E1$=EQ$:M1=1:T$="  "
225 GOSUB 1000:R1$=LEFT$(R1$,2):IFM1=7 THEN240 ELSEIFLEN(R1$)=1THEN R1$=R1$+" "
230 FOR I=1TO LEN(T$)STEP2:IFMID$(T$,I,2)<>R1$THENNEXTI:EN=EN+1:T$=T$+R1$
235 GOTO 225
240 CN=1:FOR I=1TO LEN (EQ$):TT$=MID$(EQ$,I,1):IFTT$="+"ORTT$="="THEN CN=CN+1
